target_task.speaker: client
target_task.text:
Here is the power mapping by operating mode:

With the power board connected, the primary source is the 3.3V rail (AXP2101 DCDC1, 3.5A). It powers:
- ESP32-S3 module
- INA219
- all I2C sensors on the sensor board: SCD41, BME280, and ENS160
- I2C display
- TTP223 and AM312 PIR

Controlled by ESP32 GPIO3, the 5V rail (MT3608 boost, 1200mA) powers:
- SPS30 particulate sensor
- ZE08-CH2O formaldehyde sensor
- SK6812 LEDs, but only if they are wired to 5V; that depends on the version

When USB-C is connected to the main board while the power board is absent, the 3.3V rail (ME6211A LDO, 2A) becomes active for standalone programming. It supplies the same 3.3V rail listed above; Schottky diode OR-ing allows whichever source is present to take precedence.

The 2.8–4.6V battery feeds AXP2101, which then supplies everything downstream.

In short, AXP2101 powers everything during normal operation; the LDO activates only for programming without the power board connected.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Please review the files and confirm that everything is correct.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: The documentation has been updated.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Yes, I'll review the files.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: On J\_PWR\_PWR (4-pin JST-PH), does pin 1 physically correspond to 5V or GND? To prevent the cable from creating a short, I need the main board to use matching numbering.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Pin 1 carries +5V.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Before I approve, I want to clarify the payment scope. The original milestone covered all 3 boards (power + main + sensor), so were you intending to invoice each board separately, or is this a partial payment request?

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Without checking the milestone, I went ahead and uploaded the files.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Once I have finished all the PCBs, you can pay.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Luka, hi—are you available right now?

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Yes

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Although the boards have been finalized, more changes may arise while you work, and the power board still needs one more change. There is also one small board consisting only of 16 addressable LEDs. Since the scope is larger than I anticipated, I propose accepting the current milestone and opening a new $100 milestone for these two boards plus the LED board. Is that okay?

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: The resulting total will therefore be $200.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: My apologies for responding so late.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Server work is keeping me busy right now.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: The proposed arrangement is fine with me; I have no objections.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: I'll send the boards as well within 20 minutes.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Ok

messages.speaker: client
messages.text:
Because I expect to need that LED later, the power board only requires these two changes:
1\. Add J\_LED\_CHG (4-pin JST-GH) for the CHGLED circuit with a 540Ω resistor; D1 remains DNP
2\. Change R6 from 9.4kΩ to 540Ω and remove DNP

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: This supplied artifact is the main board.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Payment received, thank you.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: I will review all the files a little later.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Thank you as well; you've done good work.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Tomas, the BAT54 specified for the Main PCB power supply is a signal diode, so it is not intended for that application.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: That component was merely something I had available for testing and is probably unsuitable, so please select the correct ones.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: So I can update the documentation, please tell me which components you select.

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Could we use SS24?

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Is ESP32 the only component powered by ME6211C33M5?

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: Thanks for checking. I originally intended it for debugging, but that LDO will not let me debug the sensors. Could we use something like ME6211A33M5 instead—what do you think?

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: A search of LCSC is not turning it up for me.

messages.speaker: freelancer
messages.text: Could you map each power supply to the components it powers?

messages.speaker: client
messages.text: I'm searching for an LDO now; give me a second.

attributes.battery_connector_placement: on the back, opposite the USB-C connector

ambiguity.description: The correct battery-connector pinout and labeling are unresolved after a possible mislabeling was identified.

attributes.ldo_capacity_requirement: The LDO must adequately power the sensors during debugging.

attributes.power_oring_diode_requirement: Use suitable power-supply diodes rather than BAT54 signal diodes.

review_notes: Every scoring leaf received an explicit reviewed comparator status.
